svg.title: Deckhand — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as deckhand, wearing a raincoat and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A tall two-turn rope coil has a loose end beside a separate broad-horned mooring cleat. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
